title: ForcePower
description: Canonical, app-owned Force-power record: the power, its ability (upgrade) definitions, and the purchase tree. Ingested ONCE from oggdude_merged.json `force_powers` (21) joined with `force_abilities.items` (186). Abilities NEST inside their power — they are never consumed outside a power-tree context (ForcePowerTreeView), and nesting kills the cross-blob join the sheet does at runtime today. Replaces the window.__SWForceData global.
$comment: INGEST CONTRACT — MinForceRating (15/21) -> min_force_rating (fad p.285: printed FR prerequisite). Source (15) OR Sources (6) -> sources[]. AbilityRows: per row, Abilities.Key[4] + Costs.Cost[4] + AbilitySpan.Span[4] + Directions.Direction[4]; consecutive repeats of one ability key with Span>1 collapse to ONE cell at its col with span; Span '0' cells are continuations/fillers — dropped; remaining cells carry to_int cost >= 1. Cell ability keys join against force_abilities items; the join is by tree reference (the redundant force_abilities.Power name-string is an integrity CHECK, not the join — 2/186 lack it). Abilities unreferenced by any tree fail loud -> adjudication. Power-name prefix 'Force Power: X' stripped from descriptions (matches FCForcePowersStep). The legacy creator hardcoded BASIC_COST=10; real basic costs span 5-20 (e.g. Farsight 5, Conjure 20) — canonical data fixes this by construction.

min_force_rating.description: Printed Force Rating prerequisite to purchase (fad p.285; e.g. Battle Meditation 'Force Rating 2+', fad p.287). Absent = no printed prerequisite.

family.description: F-100 M10 (ruling f100-m10-shapes-card R-M10S-1): the upgrade's family (FaD p.283's categories, plus `basic` and `other`). F-100 M11 (ruling f100-m11-census-card R-M11C-11): `speed` joins with its first users, reSpecialized's Speed upgrades. Optional; every canonical row carries it (the applier writes it). The editor's grouping and the census's key — no reader derives a family from a name.

commit_dice.description: The Force dice this ability commits. R-AAC-27 (b), ruling argo-a1-export-fields D3: derived from the description by scripts/canonical/apply_text_encodings.py; the app reads it, else today's parse (D4).

after_power.description: The id of the power whose successful check this ability follows. R-AAC-27 (b), ruling argo-a1-export-fields D3: derived from the description by scripts/canonical/apply_text_encodings.py; the app reads it, else today's parse (D4).

abilities.description: The power's ability definitions (basic + upgrades), keyed by local ability id. F-100 M10 (ruling f100-m10-shapes-card R-M10S-1): each carries its `family` and may carry the talent record's working-row arrays ON the ability (`pool_mods`, `effects`, `roll_numbers`, `told`; `item_effects`/`vehicle_effects` not until a node needs one), their `words`/`condition` spans indexing the ABILITY's own description (no second copy of book text, R-M8R-1). Upgrade categories per RAW: Strength/Magnitude/Duration/Range/Control/Mastery (fad p.286). Per-ability pip spends ([FP] tokens in descriptions) are display data, not mechanics (fad p.283).

tree.description: Purchase grid, top row first (row 0 = basic power). Eligibility: connected to the basic form or a previously purchased upgrade via links (fad p.286). Costs printed per cell (fad p.286).

ability.description: Key into this power's abilities map (ingest-enforced; jsonschema cannot cross-reference).

power_row_refusals.description: F-100 M10 (R-M10S-1/2): an upgrade's rows never carry `per_rank` (a scaled row reads V1's `count_of`; an upgrade row applies once while its count is ≥ 1) and never a pick (no Force-power node needs one).

power_pool_mod.description: F-100 M10 (R-M10S-1): an upgrade's dice row — item-common's pool_mod_entry as a talent's, `cost`/`limit`/`count_of` admitted; `count_of` reads the Force rating (a combined check, M1′) or V1's ranks bought.

power_effect.description: F-100 M10 (R-M10S-5, V3): an upgrade's sheet-number row — ONLY behind a commit: `cost: {commit_force: n}` is the one cost member an effect admits here (a strain cost, or no cost, is refused). Ops admitted behind a commit: characteristic_delta (a fixed `characteristic`) and skill_rank_delta (V5); others enter with their first user. Applied only while the session's committed set holds the upgrade (CharResolve's one committed-effects reader); never saved.

power_roll_number.description: F-100 M10 (R-M10S-4, V2): an upgrade's number worked out at its power's check — power_dial only (anchored by V4); other roll ops enter with their first user.

power_told.description: F-100 M10 (R-M10S-1): an upgrade's TOLD row — its own words (a span of the ability's description), shown and never computed.
